regions.note: #endButtonsHolder: v10 shows the Double XP button (the ad icon) to a guest; Krunker Box Office shows it only while the account's 2x XP offer is claimable (dxp.offer.claimable, the brain's rule: games % 3 == 0, once per match), so a guest's row has COLLECT alone and centred. Reported, not failed, by design (double_xp_offer.c). The COLLECT button is unchanged.
